title: AI Persona Kit
description: Settings shared by the in-browser AI personas: command approvals, chat rendering of command outputs and agent skills

commandsRequiringApproval.title: Commands Requiring Approval
commandsRequiringApproval.description: List of commands that require user approval before AI can execute them

commandsAutoRenderMimeBundles.title: Commands Auto-Rendering MIME Bundles
commandsAutoRenderMimeBundles.description: List of execute_command command IDs whose outputs can auto-render MIME bundles in chat

trustedMimeTypesForAutoRender.title: Trusted MIME Types for Auto-Render
trustedMimeTypesForAutoRender.description: MIME types to mark as trusted when auto-rendering execute_command outputs in chat

skillsPaths.title: Skills Paths
skillsPaths.description: Paths to directories containing agent skills, relative to the server root. Skills are loaded from all paths; the first occurrence of a skill name takes priority.
